# Model and taxonomy evidence placeholder

No occupational coding model is distributed in version 0.1.0.

Before execution can be enabled, a reviewed release must document:

- model, taxonomy, training-data, and publisher provenance;
- redistribution and field-use terms;
- supported industry/occupation coding schemes and effective dates;
- input normalization, candidate ranking, confidence calibration, and no-match behavior;
- independent synthetic fixtures with expected candidates, order, probabilities,
  codes, titles, and scheme;
- differential review against an authorized reference implementation;
- privacy, accessibility, offline, storage, performance, and browser evidence;
- update, rollback, support, deprecation, and emergency revocation owners.

The model must not be added merely because legacy binary assets can be found.
